}

{
  "cypher": "MATCH (a:AircraftModel) WHERE a.name = 'North American P-51 Mustang'
MATCH (b:AircraftModel) WHERE b.name = 'Boeing 737-500'

       toFloat(a.wingspan_metre) AS wingspanA,
       b.name AS modelB,
       toFloat(b.wingspan_metre) AS wingspanB,
       CASE
         WHEN toFloat(a.wingspan_metre) > toFloat(b.wingspan_metre) THEN a.name
         WHEN toFloat(a.wingspan_metre) < toFloat(b.wingspan_metre) THEN b.name
         ELSE 'Equal'
       END AS greater_wingspan_model"
  ,
  "rationale": "The query matches the two aircraft models by their `name` property, converts their `wingspan_metre` values to numbers, returns each model with its wingspan, and includes a computed column indicating which model has the greater wingspan."
}

       ABS(toFloat(m1.height_metre) - toFloat(m2.height_metre)) AS height_difference_meters"
  ,
  "rationale": "The query matches the two AircraftModel nodes that correspond to the requested aircraft (using either the exact name or any alias), retrieves their height_metre values, converts them to floats, and returns the absolute difference in meters."
}

      (f2:FlightAccident {flight_number: "All Nippon Airways Flight 60"})

       f1.date           AS date1,
       f2.flight_number AS flight2,
       f2.date           AS date2,
       CASE WHEN date(f1.date) > date(f2.date) THEN f1.flight_number ELSE f2.flight_number END AS more_recent_flight,
       CASE WHEN date(f1.date) > date(f2.date) THEN f1.date           ELSE f2.date           END AS more_recent_date

WHERE f1.flight_number CONTAINS "American Eagle Flight 5456"

       f1.date           AS date1,
       f2.flight_number AS flight2,
       f2.date           AS date2,
       CASE WHEN date(f1.date) > date(f2.date) THEN f1.flight_number ELSE f2.flight_number END AS more_recent_flight,

  op1.launch_year AS launch_year1,
  op2.name AS operator2,

    WHEN toInteger(op1.launch_year) < toInteger(op2.launch_year) THEN op2.name 
    ELSE 'Both have the same launch year' 
  END AS later_launch_year_operator"
